create_denoising_dataset: create a DenoisingDataset wrapper for BART with configurable masking, insertion, and rotation noise
build_collate_batch: build a mini-batch from samples by merging source tokens, targets, and prev output tokens
add_whole_word_mask: add whole word masking noise to source tokens with configurable mask ratio and span distribution
add_insertion_noise: add insertion noise to tokens by inserting random or mask tokens at random positions
permute_sentences: permute sentence order in source tokens by detecting full stops and shuffling sentence boundaries
